wl_help:
# ✅ Whitelist Command

Global whitelist (works in all servers).

## Usage
**Add:** `{prefix}wl add <user/id>`
**Remove:** `{prefix}wl remove <user/id>`
**Clear:** `{prefix}wl clear`
**Show:** `{prefix}wl show`

-# Limits: Normal {limit_normal} | Prime {limit_prime}
wl_add_need_user:
{emoji} Mention a valid **User** or provide **ID**.

**Usage:** `{prefix}wl add @user` or `{prefix}wl add 1099721566633349181`
wl_remove_need_user:
{emoji} Mention a valid **User** or provide **ID**.

**Usage:** `{prefix}wl remove @user` or `{prefix}wl remove 1099721566633349181`
wl_invalid_user: {emoji} Invalid user (or you cannot whitelist bots).
wl_already: {emoji} This user is already in your **Whitelist**.
wl_not_in_list: {emoji} This user is not in your **Whitelist**.

setup_help:
# ⚙️ Temp Voice Setup

**Usage:**
> `.v setup show`
> `.v setup jtc <voice_channel | channel_id>`
> `.v setup rejectedtap <voice_channel | channel_id>`
> `.v setup rolehide <@role | role_id>`
> `.v setup eventhoster <@role | role_id>`
> `.v setup eventhoster clear`
> `.v setup backup <category_id>`
> `.v setup name <template>`
> `.v setup staffroles <@role | role_id> [@role2 | role_id2 ...]`
> `.v setup staffroles clear`
> `.v setup log <#channel | channel_id>`
> `.v setup prefix <new_prefix>`
> `.v setup lang <en | fr | ar>`
> `.v setup theme #7BC9F4`
> `.v setup theme reset`
> `.v setup reset`

## 🧩 Name placeholders
> `{user}` will be replaced with the voice owner username.
